selected_entry_before.title: The parabolic highest-weight truncation factors through the cyclotomic quotient
selected_entry_before.statement: For a nonempty pyramid and arbitrary complex origins c, put a_j=c_j+q_j−n. For d≥1, the raw tensor operator x_1 on V_c^tensor d has minimal polynomial exactly product_j(x−a_j), including repeated roots with their multiplicities. Thus its H_d action factors through H_d(a). The ordinary Casimir action on P_c tensor V^tensor d likewise factors through this polynomial when P_c is the ground induced module with its genuine column filtration. This does not assert that every unrelated standard N(A) or every parabolic category-O object carries that same tensor action. For d=0 there is no x_1. Integral-root Λ and arbitrary-root coset Λ use the separate conventions in the preceding definition.
selected_entry_before.strategy: Assume AC and work over C. The first tensor step of P_c has a column filtration; its scalar on the jth quotient is a_j by the trace Casimir difference. Successively apply x_1−a_j along that filtration to annihilate the tensor module; tensoring the remaining factors retains this identity. Transfer it through the explicit Skryabin tensor matrix to the raw space. Assign v_i column degree col(i); the leading x_1 is e on the first factor, whose largest string has length l. A polynomial of degree<l would have a nonzero leading e power and cannot vanish. Thus the degree-l polynomial is minimal, also when roots coincide. This proof needs no integral category-O identification for arbitrary c and no blanket assertion about all x_j eigenvalues.

selected_entry_after.title: The parabolic highest-weight truncation factors through the cyclotomic quotient
selected_entry_after.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Choice [[def-axiom-of-choice]] only for the imported
Skryabin equivalence identifying the raw Whittaker bimodule and its affine
action. The finite raw-matrix polynomial and minimal-polynomial calculations
and the ordinary $P_c\otimes V$ column-flag calculation are choice-free.

Let $\lambda=(0\le p_1\le\cdots\le p_n)$ be a nonempty pyramid with columns
$q_1\ge\cdots\ge q_l>0$, let $c=(c_1,\dots,c_l)$ be arbitrary complex origins,
and put $a_j=c_j+q_j-n$ for $1\le j\le l$. For $d\ge1$ consider the raw
tensor operator $x_1$ on the truncated tensor space $V_c^{\otimes d}$ of
[[def-deformed-tensor-space-for-the-type-a-finite-w-algebra]] (whose underlying
space is $V^{\otimes d}$ and whose $x_1$ is the operator displayed there).
Then the minimal polynomial of $x_1$ on $V_c^{\otimes d}$ is exactly
$$\prod_{j=1}^l(x-a_j),$$
including repeated roots with their multiplicities. Consequently the action of
$H_d$ on $V_c^{\otimes d}$ factors through the cyclotomic quotient
$H_d(\mathbf a)$ of [[def-degenerate-cyclotomic-hecke-algebra]]. The same
polynomial annihilates the action of the ordinary Casimir operator on
$P_c\otimes V^{\otimes d}$, where $P_c$ is the ground induced module with its
genuine column filtration.

The statement does not assert that every unrelated standard object $N(A)$, or
every parabolic category-$\mathcal O$ object, carries that same tensor action.
For $d=0$ there is no operator $x_1$. The integral-root weight $\Lambda$ and
the arbitrary-root coset bookkeeping are the separate conventions of
[[def-degenerate-cyclotomic-hecke-algebra]].
selected_entry_after.strategy: Define the full raw operator locally with the sum over every later tensor position $k=2,\ldots,d$, using the same physical box labels and arbitrary origins. Assume AC only for the actual Skryabin equivalence used to establish this raw affine action: evaluate its balanced tensor map on actual Whittaker preimages and separate the diagonal, negative character, first-position and later-position terms to recover the raw display. This model is $Q_\chi\otimes_W\mathbb C_c$, not the ordinary ground module. The first-column flag $C_b$ satisfies $C_b(x_1-a_b)\subseteq C_{b-1}$, so every column factor, including repeated roots, annihilates in succession. With total grading $\deg v_j=l-\operatorname{col}(j)$, the left shift has degree one and each cross-position exchange degree zero; hence $\operatorname{gr}_1x_1=e^{(1)}$, and nonvanishing powers below $l$ prove exact minimal degree. The affine action therefore factors through the cyclotomic quotient. Separately define the ordinary ground module $P_c=U(\mathfrak g)\otimes_{U(\mathfrak p)}\mathbb C_\mu$, with $\mu_b=c_b+\sum_{h\le b}q_h-n$. PBW right-freeness and the coproduct tensor identity induce the natural column flag on $P_c\otimes V$, not on $P_c$ itself. On a ground tensor $m_0\otimes v_j$, $\Omega=\sum E_{ab}\otimes E_{ba}$ contributes $\mu_b$ from the diagonal, zero from non-diagonal parabolic terms, and subtracts one for each earlier-column box after rewriting the lower-block term through the tensor identity. The other term lands in the earlier flag piece. Thus the quotient scalar is $\mu_b-\sum_{h<b}q_h=c_b+q_b-n=a_b$. Ambient $\mathfrak g$-linearity extends this to the entire quotient and preserves the flag, proving the same annihilating polynomial on $P_c\otimes V$. Tensoring the remaining factors proves the ordinary $P_c\otimes V^{\otimes d}$ claim. Handle $d=0$ without a nonexistent $x_1$. Preserve arbitrary complex origins, every nonempty shape and repeated-root multiplicities. The Deformed definition is declared for the retained actual model context after its redundant dependence on this lemma is removed; the proof calculations remain local. No ordinary-to-plain-Skryabin identification, FDE reindexing or integral-category identification is used.
